```python
# Unit test for function median
def test_median():
    # Odd number of elements
    assert median([3, 1, 2]) == 2
    assert median([5, 3, 8, 1, 9]) == 5

    # Even number of elements
    assert median([1, 2, 3, 4]) == 2.5
    assert median([10, 20]) == 15.0

    # Single element
    assert median([7]) == 7

    # Two elements
    assert median([4, 2]) == 3.0

    # Unsorted input gets sorted
    assert median([9, 1, 5, 3]) == 4.0

    # Negative numbers
    assert median([-5, -1, -3]) == -3
    assert median([-10, 10]) == 0.0

    # Floats
    assert median([1.5, 2.5, 3.5]) == 2.5
    assert abs(median([1.1, 2.2, 3.3, 4.4]) - 2.75) < 1e-9

    # Duplicates
    assert median([2, 2, 2, 2]) == 2.0
    assert median([1, 2, 2, 3]) == 2.0

    # Mixed ints and floats
    assert median([1, 2.5, 3]) == 2.5

    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_median()
```
